actions.action: Lift the plant out of the pot and check root health
If roots are dry, brittle or mushy, trim the bad ones
Check whether the soil stays wet and whether the stem base is mushy or dark
Keep the plant in its nursery pot inside the cachepot and empty any pooled water
Water thoroughly until it drains out the bottom, then empty the saucer
Check that the soil is completely dry before watering again
Move the plant to the brightest window
Feed lightly with diluted succulent fertilizer in spring and summer
If the stem or roots are rotting, take a stem-tip cutting, let it callus and root it in dry soil

reason: The answer correctly names underwatering as the main cause and hints that the roots aren't taking up water, but it never suggests soaking the pot to rehydrate soil that won't absorb water; its advice to water thoroughly and be patient is incomplete rather than harmful.
